the identification and prioritization of risks in ports in Turkey using a hybrid approach based on failure mode effects analysis (FMEA) and the intuitionistic fuzzy technique for order preference by similarity to an ideal solution (IF-TOPSIS).
the risk analysis of the port in Turkey, which is one of the most active ports in the world, using the failure mode and effect method and the intuitionistic fuzzy TOPIS method.
the identification of risks in ports and the evaluation of the risk levels in the port using a model based on FMEA and intuitionistic fuzzy TOPIS.
